Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Your Desktop workspace in a browser tab** — The new Webapp serves the full Desktop workspace from your own gateway: the same chats, Group Chats, plugins and settings, in any browser on your network or behind a public URL with sign-in. The Docker image and Nix package ship it. It is off by default; turn it on with `webapp.enabled` or Web Access in Settings. ([#141864](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141864), [#145598](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145598),

**One gateway owns every conversation** — Before, the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors (ACP), messaging bots and cron could each run their own copy of the agent against the same chat, which is how messages got written twice or went missing between surfaces. Now each machine runs one gateway that owns every session, and every surface attaches to it as a client: a chat you open anywhere is the same chat, with one queue and one history. You can even steer or edit a queued prompt from Desktop without it r

**Pictures in the terminal** — When you paste an image, or a tool takes a screenshot, the CLI and TUI now draw it right in the chat instead of printing a file path: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty (CLI and TUI) and in iTerm2, WezTerm and Konsole (CLI), coloured blocks everywhere else, and full resolution in VS Code's terminal when its image support is on. ([#147293](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147293), [#148874](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148874) — @

**Rewind a conversation** — Press Esc twice or type `/rewind` in the TUI or classic CLI, pick an earlier message, then edit and resend it or fork a new session from that point. The original session stays exactly as it was. The TUI can also start `/new` while a turn is still running; the old one keeps working in the background. ([#144937](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144937), [#148880](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148880) — @SaguaroDev)

**Every machine in one Desktop window** — Desktop now keeps all your gateways connected at once, so switching between this computer and an SSH or remote gateway is instant. Terminal tabs run on the host they were opened on, and a Group Chat can mix bots from different machines. ([#147681](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147681), [#147708](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147708), [#148418](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148418) — @dskwe, @jan

**Group Chats that run themselves** — Bot Mode rooms can let a lead bot, or an automatic router, pick who answers a message that names nobody. Scheduled jobs can post into a room, rooms keep a purpose and shared notes, and bots no longer ping each other in endless loops. Rooms also look like a normal Hermes chat now, and each bot shows what it is doing live ("scout · terminal · 7s"). ([#144833](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144833), [#148417](https://github.com/NousResearch/h

**Plugins that keep themselves current** — `hermes plugins update` updates everything at once, and an opt-in Auto-update switch (CLI, chat, Desktop and dashboard) keeps catalog and git plugins up to date. Updates that would break your setup are held back instead of applied. The catalog itself grew from about 600 to over 1,050 entries, and a new Verified tier marks plugins built by the vendor itself. ([#141513](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141513), [#85794](https://github.com

**Price tags and spend limits for paid tools** — Paid MCP tools, such as 3D or media generation, can declare what a call costs. The approval prompt shows each call's price and the chat's running total, and Hermes asks before a chat goes over its limit, even in YOLO mode. ([#142470](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142470), [#143780](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143780), [#143795](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143795), [#143787](https://gi

**New official plugins, and a smaller core** — Meshy (text and image to 3D), ElevenLabs Music and Sound Effects, X Chat, REA (reverse engineering) and a bubblewrap sandbox are now one-command installs. Camofox, `mcp-serve`, the agent importers and Singularity moved out of core into plugins that install themselves for anyone who used them. ([#142619](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142619), [#146294](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146294), [#139725](https://gi

**Choose how subagents are run** — Delegation is now pluggable: keep the default, or install the official `advanced-delegation` plugin to send each subagent task to a named model or into a separate profile. Switch with `/delegation`. ([#142563](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142563), [#142564](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142564), [#143423](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143423))

**Lighter and faster, especially when Hermes runs all day** — Recurring cron jobs share a prompt cache, one-shot runs send about 1,570 fewer prompt tokens per call, and `patch`/`write_file` return in milliseconds with LSP on. Long-lived gateways now let go of closed sessions' memory, and the Desktop sidebar no longer slows down as sessions pile up (one store with ~35k cron runs went from a 121 s refresh to instant). ([#139876](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139876), [#144177](

**A leaner skill set you can lock** — The built-in skills went from 58 to 44, with Word, PowerPoint and Excel merged into one `microsoft-office` skill. `hermes curator lock` stops the agent from rewriting a skill you curated by hand, through any tool, even in YOLO mode. ([#147557](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147557) — @daviseford)

**Password managers and a keychain vault key** — Verified password-manager plugins can hand the browser your logins without seeing anyone else's, and the browser vault's key can now live in your OS keychain. ([#143964](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143964), [#144246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144246) — @Jesssullivan)

**Stop a running cron job** — Cancel a running job from the CLI, Desktop, the API or the agent itself, and set per job what happens to runs missed while Hermes was off. ([#144801](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144801) — @kokhlo, @fangliquanflq, @LeonSGP43)

Static provider credentials without placement metadata now resolve only in the `Authorization` header or through explicitly enabled body/WebSocket rewrite policies, so custom headers such as `x-api-key`, query parameters, and path slots need an explicit placement declaration. Upgrade the gateway before the supervisor, and update existing imported profiles as needed, since editing reference YAML alone does not update the gateway catalog. `auth_style` selects the active placement, and fields for o

REST endpoints now return `403` for HTTP upgrade requests in both enforce and audit modes. Configure WebSocket traffic with `protocol: websocket` and explicit handshake and message rules; `websocket_credential_rewrite: true` now requires a WebSocket endpoint. [#5336](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5336)

OCSF sandbox attribution moved: supervisor events use `device.container.uid` and `device.container.name`, gateway API Activity and Detection Finding events use `resources` entries with `type: "sandbox"`, and other gateway classes use `unmapped.sandbox_id` and `unmapped.sandbox_name`. SIEM parsers that read top-level `container.uid` or `container.name` must update their mappings. [#5048](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5048)

Sandboxes now fail to launch when a filesystem policy path goes through a symlink inside a writable workspace, including in best-effort mode. Use the symlink's target path in the policy instead. [#5278](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5278)

Transparent TCP connections now evaluate IPv4-mapped IPv6 destinations as IPv4. Change endpoint rules such as `host: "::ffff:203.0.113.7"` to `host: "203.0.113.7"`. [#5101](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5101)

The `openshell` Python SDK is now published from [ai-openshell/sdk-python](https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-python) starting with `0.1.8`, and core GitHub Releases no longer attach its wheel or checksum. Keep installing it with `pip install openshell` from PyPI. [#5350](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5350)

The Go SDK module `github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/sdk/go` is deprecated. Switch to `github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go`, now developed in [ai-openshell/sdk-go](https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go). [#5245](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5245)

The Go SDK now shares `oidc_token.json` with the CLI, and `v1.RefreshableToken` no longer returns an expired cached token after a failed refresh for any token source. Run `openshell gateway login` once to replace token files written by earlier Go SDK releases. [#4830](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4830)

Gateway interceptors can now intercept sandbox start, stop, suspend, and resume RPCs. After you upgrade and restart the gateway, dynamic interceptor registrations that advertise these RPCs can start intercepting them, while strict allowlist or exact registrations need matching operator configuration. [#5173](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5173)

Deleted sandboxes no longer leave memory behind on the gateway, so repeated create/delete cycles no longer grow gateway memory until it is OOM-killed. [#5428](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5428)
The gateway no longer pre-allocates about 3.4 MiB of stream buffers for every sandbox. [#5408](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5408)

When PostgreSQL is unreachable, gateway requests now fail within about 5 seconds with a retryable `UNAVAILABLE` error, and a gateway started during the outage becomes ready once the database returns instead of crash-looping. [#5244](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5244)
Deleting a sandbox on Kubernetes no longer waits out the pod's 30-second termination grace period. [#5279](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5279)

A sandbox no longer exits when its control listener hits a transient accept error such as `EMFILE`, and DNS over TCP keeps working after a client resets a connection before it is accepted. [#5211](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5211)
On Kubernetes, a late status update during a stop no longer flips a stopped sandbox back to `Provisioning` and blocks the next stop. [#5196](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5196)
AWS SigV4 signing diagnostics no longer appear in supervisor TRACE logs, where they could expose the temporary session token. [#4558](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4558)
Provider attachment now checks credential inspection against the sandbox's latest saved policy instead of its creation policy. [#5310](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5310)

SSH relays and service forwards now have separate per-sandbox connection limits, set with `max_ssh_connections_per_sandbox` and `max_service_connections_per_sandbox` in the gateway config (default 20). [#5063](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5063)

The CLI now renews expired OIDC client credentials tokens by repeating the grant instead of failing with `no refresh token available`. Renewal needs `OPENSHELL_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` to be set. [#4389](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4389)
`openshell sandbox download` now works on busybox-based images. [#5420](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5420)
`openshell policy update --add-endpoint` now accepts the `allow-encoded-slash` option. [#4968](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4968)
`openshell status --gateway <name>` now exits non-zero when the named gateway is not registered. [#5379](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5379)
Podman sandbox deletion and create rollback now remove only volumes labeled as owned by that sandbox, and keep any others with a warning. [#4714](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4714)

Binary identity resolution now bounds its procfs work per mediated connection, so long command lines and digest-cache churn no longer slow connects without limit. Hashing a large, uncached executable can still delay a connect. [#5213](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5213)

Isolation descriptors with an invalid workload identity, such as UID or GID 0 or an empty source or resource digest, now fail to deserialize instead of being accepted. [#5192](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5192)
Sandbox signal masks are now built from zero-initialized memory, which fixes reads of uninitialized bytes on 64-bit musl. [#5194](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5194)
`openshell-gateway config preflight` now warns when `allow_unauthenticated_users` is enabled. [#5105](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5105)
The Docker driver now warns at startup when Docker Engine is older than the documented 28.0 minimum. [#5369](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5369)
The TUI policy viewer now shows each allowed or denied MCP tool name or pattern instead of `tools/call *`. [#5345](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5345)
The TypeScript SDK now revokes SSH forward tokens when you call `forward().close()`. [#5079](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5079)
The Go SDK now falls back to the system `active_gateway` when the user one is missing or invalid, matching the CLI. [#4917](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4917)
The Go SDK now sets up `Listen` tunnels in parallel, so one slow setup no longer blocks other clients. [#4995](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4995)

The Python SDK adds an opt-in `delete_timeout_seconds` on `Sandbox` and a `timeout_seconds` argument on `delete`, for Kubernetes pods that take longer than 30 seconds to terminate. [#4697](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4697)
The installer no longer prints awk escape warnings while looking up RPM assets. [#4845](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4845)
VM runtime tarballs now record the libkrunfw commit, kernel version, and kernel config hash, including on macOS. [#4650](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4650)

The metrics listener can now serve `/metrics` over TLS, with optional mutual TLS, configured through gateway TOML, CLI flags, environment variables, or Helm Secrets. Plaintext remains the default. [#3877](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3877)

In multi-replica gateways, shared-supervisor pool sandbox sessions now stay on the gateway replica that serves their supervisor, including across gateway and supervisor failures. [#5052](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5052)
Supervisors now advertise the application routes they have installed, so gateways can discover them for both dedicated and shared supervisors. [#4940](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4940)

OCSF HTTP and API audit events now correlate with sampled OpenTelemetry traces, and OTLP log records carry trace and span context. More refusal findings are now classified as Denied, which can increase denial-query counts. [#4789](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4789)
The CLI now forwards `TRACEPARENT` and `TRACESTATE` from its environment to the gateway, so CI pipeline traces parent gateway spans. [#2931](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/2931)
The Kubernetes driver adds a `supervisor_runtime_class_name` setting for dedicated supervisor pods. [#5349](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5349)
The Helm chart now supports `priorityClassName` and `topologySpreadConstraints` for the gateway pod. [#2832](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/2832)

Documentation now uses "OpenShell" in place of "NVIDIA OpenShell", and the README announces the project's planned move to the CNCF and the ai-openshell organization. [#5441](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5441)
Documentation clarifies security boundaries, supervisor recovery, credential rotation, and native inference guidance. [#5331](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5331)

Observability docs now show where each OTLP signal goes, including relayed agent traces, and document log retention for each driver. [#5153](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5153), [#4901](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4901)
Stable releases now publish the public protobuf schemas to `buf.build/openshell/core`. [#5208](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5208)

Stable releases now publish Python wheels directly to PyPI through a dispatchable publisher job. [#5157](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5157), [#5222](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5222)
Security reports can now be filed through a structured private vulnerability reporting form. [#5203](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5203)

Moved credential storage and built-in refresh execution into an embedded credential issuer, with no change to commands, configuration, or APIs. [#5266](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5266), [#5283](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5283)
Updated h2 in the E2E harness for RUSTSEC-2026-0258 and temporarily acknowledged a SQLite advisory until a compatible SQLx release is available. [#5392](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5392)
Removed the unused regorus `yaml` feature. [#4882](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4882)
Removed unused compute driver registration hooks and an unused Landlock helper. [#5382](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5382), [#5221](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5221)
Documented every unsafe block in the sandbox crate and enforced `SAFETY` comments with clippy. [#5232](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5232)

Added area and topic reviewer rosters with automatic reviewer routing that does not require write access. [#4863](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4863), [#5257](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5257)

Made the Codex Security check advisory and kept SDK error messages in compatibility reviews. [#5246](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5246), [#5292](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5292)
Development and CI Kubernetes environments now enable OTLP export only when a collector is requested. [#5348](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5348)

Added the `openshell-conformance` test program and ran tmachine conformance rows with the prebuilt binary. [#5249](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5249), [#5332](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5332)
Migrated the features and drivers E2E suites to testkit. [#5137](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5137)

Ported the credential gating E2E tests to conformance and split them into independent parallel tests. [#5318](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5318), [#5264](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5264)

Added a conformance test for prompt deletion when a workload is slow to handle TERM, ignored until the supervisor fix lands. [#5291](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5291), [#5338](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5338)

Added testkit cleanup hooks that run after pass, failure, or panic, with typed hook keys. [#5219](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5219), [#5240](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5240)
Testkit errors now name unsupported gateway auth modes. [#5248](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5248)
Added a test that keeps relays queued during session setup until `SessionAccepted`. [#4689](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4689)
Restored package-installed Podman qualification in tmachine. [#4289](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4289)

Prepared tmachine runner environments for the E2E migration, ran Ansible with a dumb terminal, and noted that tmachine runs on macOS. [#5277](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5277), [#5307](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5307), [#5304](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5304)

Sped up E2E CI by starting Linux and tmachine jobs without waiting on macOS or package builds and by building tmachine suite bundles once per run. [#5270](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5270), [#5432](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5432)
Pinned the k3s installer used in tests to a release. [#5223](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5223)

**Breaking:** OpenShell now emits native OCSF 1.8.0 records only, so deployments that relied on 1.1 or 1.3 records now receive 1.8.0. The `ocsf_schema_version` setting, the gateway `schema_version` fields, Helm `server.ocsfLog.schemaVersion`, and `OPENSHELL_OTLP_OCSF_SCHEMA_VERSION` are deprecated and ignored, and setting them logs a warning. [#5036](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5036)

The Podman-only `[openshell.drivers.podman].additional_ca_bundle` setting from v0.1.5 still works, but it is deprecated in favor of the new `[openshell.supervisor.network].additional_ca_bundle`. The old key is only honored when Podman is the active compute driver. [#5155](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5155)

On the MicroVM driver, sandboxes from registry images and rootfs tars now run as the image's `sandbox` account, as documented, instead of always running as `1000:1000`. New sandboxes from images whose `sandbox` account isn't UID 1000 now run under that UID, and requesting the image's own UID with `run_as_user` now works. [#5131](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5131)

`config preflight` and gateway startup now reject an `[openshell.gateway.supervisor_pool]` table when the selected driver doesn't use shared supervision, and they reject a pool recovery timeout shorter than member failure detection. [#4988](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4988)

Shared-pool sandboxes whose supervisor stays gone past the 60-second recovery deadline now show as `Stopped`, and `sandbox start` runs them again. [#5076](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5076)

When the shared supervisor pool can't place a sandbox, `sandbox create` now says why: the pool isn't ready, no replica is attached, no replica has room, or placement failed. [#4985](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4985)
VM sandboxes now start when the gateway runs with a restrictive umask, such as the packaged `UMask=0077`. [#5099](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5099)
For direct connections, address selection from policy DNS now goes through the same destination checks as endpoint decisions. [#5004](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5004)
The gateway now accepts a supervisor's full 200-line reconnect log backlog instead of silently dropping half of it. [#5049](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5049)

OCSF events from the supervisor and gateway now pass validation against the official OCSF 1.8.0 schema. [#4288](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4288), [#5020](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5020)

Vulnerable Rust dependencies are updated, including `zip` (GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj), `russh` and `pageant` (open Dependabot alerts), and `pulldown-cmark`, and the unmaintained `rustls-pemfile` parser is replaced. [#5026](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5026), [#5030](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5030), [#5122](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5122), [#5123](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5123)

Kubernetes sandboxes can now update their image, command, environment, and metadata without being recreated or losing persistent storage. Updates require operator activation and a stopped sandbox, and stopping a completed, failed, or timed-out sandbox now moves it to `Stopped` while keeping its exit code or timeout diagnosis. [#4873](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4873)

Sandboxed agents can send OpenTelemetry traces to your collector without an egress rule: add `[openshell.gateway.otlp.agent]` with `enabled = true` to `gateway.toml`, and the supervisor tags each span with the sandbox id before forwarding it. [#4276](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4276)

OTLP export can now use OTLP/HTTP: set `protocol = "http/protobuf"` on `[openshell.gateway.otlp]` or any of its signal tables, with gRPC remaining the default. An OTLP endpoint that includes a query string is now a configuration error. [#5082](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5082)

OTLP collectors that require authentication or routing headers are now supported through `headers` or `headers_file` on `[openshell.gateway.otlp]` or a signal table. Supervisors and the agent trace relay send them too, so MLflow can ingest relayed agent traces directly with `x-mlflow-experiment-id`. [#5083](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5083)

OTLP collectors can use a private CA and mutual TLS: set `ca_file`, and optionally `cert_file` and `key_file`, on `[openshell.gateway.otlp]` or a signal table. The agent trace relay and OTLP/HTTP export now also support `https://` collectors. [#5084](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5084)

Sandbox egress can now trust private PKI through `[openshell.supervisor.network].additional_ca_bundle`, which adds a PEM bundle on top of the default roots for every first-party compute driver. [#3292](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3292)

A new opt-in supervisor TLS listener lets declared HTTP and WebSocket sandbox services take application traffic directly, without going through the gateway. It is disabled by default. [#4936](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4936)

When several gateways share a Kubernetes cluster, ingress, and wildcard certificate, you can set `service_hostname_format = "hashed"` under `[openshell.gateway]` to give each exposed service a unique hostname. The default `readable` format is unchanged. [#4842](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4842)

The Rust, Go, Python, and TypeScript SDKs now send exec calls straight to the gateway replica that owns the sandbox when replica routing is enabled. Go also routes port-forward and SSH tunnel calls this way, and TypeScript routes port-forward. [#4790](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4790), [#4852](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4852), [#4918](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4918), [#4877](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4877)

CLI browser login now works when the CLI runs inside a container: set `OPENSHELL_CALLBACK_PORT` to fix the callback port and `OPENSHELL_CALLBACK_BIND_ADDRESS` to change the bind address. The defaults are unchanged. [#5065](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5065)
The Python gRPC bindings now ship typed sync and async stubs, so editors and type checkers know the concrete request and response types. [#5040](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5040)
Embedders can opt into a system-OpenSSL crypto backend; AWS-LC remains the default. [#4843](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4843)

The Podman container gateway docs now give a tested mTLS procedure and list every cause of the `--tls-cert is required when TLS is enabled` startup error. [#4977](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4977), [#5001](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5001)
The service expose example in the docs now uses an image that includes Python. [#4197](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4197)

Stable release publication can now be retried safely without overwriting published artifacts, each release publisher can be dispatched on its own, and Release Dev keeps publishing when a snap upload or Go SDK tag fails. [#4986](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4986), [#4987](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4987), [#5018](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5018)
The temporary v0.1.6 protobuf compatibility exception was removed from release qualification. [#4978](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4978)
OCSF tests now validate events against the JSON Schemas exported by the OCSF schema server. [#5019](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5019)

The conformance suites moved onto testkit and now run through the new test runner, including on tmachine and in the host E2E lanes. [#4773](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4773), [#4774](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4774), [#5078](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5078)

Feature tests can now use services started by the test environment, beginning with Keycloak. [#4891](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4891), [#5089](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5089)

E2E fixes: the shared supervisor harness now works with gateway TLS, and kind now gets its Calico images through the runner mirror. [#4984](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4984), [#5178](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5178)

The Gator agent launcher can run on Kubernetes gateways with reusable tooling images, and it now applies manifest settings to the launched sandbox only. [#4744](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4744), [#4888](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4888)

Build fixes: worktree builds no longer rebuild `openshell-core` every time, Windows lint passes again, and local image builds send a smaller build context. [#4947](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4947), [#5021](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5021)

Dependency updates: OpenTelemetry 0.33 and rustls 0.23.46 in the test and example crates. [#5081](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5081), [#4994](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4994), [#4996](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4996), [#4997](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4997), [#4998](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4998)
Divesh Chowdary ([@FrostGod](https://github.com/FrostGod)) joined the OpenShell maintainers. [#5175](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/5175)
Fix Anthropic agents failing when no model is set: the default is now
The `claude-agent-sdk` provider now defaults to `claude-sonnet-4-6` instead of
Default OpenAI model is now `gpt-5.6-terra` instead of `gpt-5-mini`, which
Fix cost reports pricing Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 at the older Claude 5
The Claude and Claude Agent SDK example workflows now use `claude-sonnet-4-6`

**[Automatic Issue Detection](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/ai-insights/detect-issues/)**: Turn recurring agent failures into issues you can investigate and fix. The dedicated Issues tab groups related problems and links findings to trace evidence; schedule detection to keep checking new traffic. (#27193, #26751, #26754, #26791, #26919, #26955, #26961, #26967, #27009, #27002, #27003, #27006, #27137, #27181, #27249, @tanghaoji; #27070, @B-Step62)

**[Skill Registry](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/skill-registry/)**: Share your team's expertise across agents and projects with a central catalog of reusable skills. Discover existing skills and choose the version or alias to use in each agent. Experimental. (#26736, @mprahl; #26900, @bardenr; #27088, @Rohitkanithi)

**[Revamped Evaluation and Trace Comparisons for Finding Regressions](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/)**: Find the regressions hidden behind aggregate scores before you ship an agent update. The redesigned comparison UI takes you from score changes to the inputs, conversations, and trace steps behind them. An [experimental Python API](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/comparing-evaluation-runs/) adds statistical comparisons to help distinguish improvements from

**[Online Evaluation](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/automatic-evaluations/)**: Catch production quality regressions with custom code-based checks that automatically assess new traces and multi-turn conversations as they arrive. Code-based online evaluation is experimental and requires a self-hosted server configured with [job containers](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/job-containers/). `databricks aitools install --output json` now reports a more specific `error_category` (`MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FILESYSTEM`) for some failures it reported as `UNCATEGORIZED`. ([#7380](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7380))

Suggest `databricks auth logout --profile <profile-name> --delete` when multiple profiles match the same workspace in `databricks auth docker` commands. ([#7363](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7363))

Fix `%pip` in Jupyter notebooks opened over `databricks ssh connect` on serverless environment versions 5 and 6 and on dedicated clusters running recent Databricks Runtime versions, which fell back to the stock IPython magic instead of the Databricks one. ([#7263](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7263))
`databricks air run` now validates the config server-side while it uploads the run artifacts, instead of before, which shortens submission. ([#7368](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7368))
Remove `CRITICAL` as a valid `compute.priority_class` value; the AI Runtime API no longer accepts it. ([#7371](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7371))

Built-in templates add the workspace ID to `workspace.host` (`?w=<id>`) when the profile or an environment variable sets it, so generated bundles select the right workspace on hosts shared by several workspaces. Welcome messages show the same URL, and `dbt-sql` also adds `?o=<id>` to the HTTP path it suggests for `dbt init`. ([#7350](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7350))

Fix grants of a renamed or recreated catalog, schema, volume or other UC resource staying recorded under the old name, which made the next `bundle plan` propose to apply them again. ([#7345](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7345))

Fix permissions of a recreated pipeline, app, dashboard, model serving endpoint or other resource staying recorded under the old ID, which made every later `bundle plan` propose to apply them again. ([#7361](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7361))
Add the `postgres_data_apis` resource (Private Preview) for enabling and configuring the Data API of a Lakebase Postgres database. ([#7160](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7160))

Fixes [#4012](https://github.com/databricks/cli/issues/4012): registered model `aliases` are now set in Unity Catalog on deploy instead of being silently ignored. A model without an `aliases` section keeps the aliases set outside the bundle (for example by MLflow), and `aliases: []` removes them. ([#7163](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7163))

Include variable declarations and the source of each resolved value in the `--include-locations` output of `bundle validate` and `bundle summary`. ([#7351](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7351))

Add `.workspace.URLID` to bundle templates: the workspace ID that `.workspace.URL` adds, or empty, so templates can use it without failing when the ID is unknown. ([#7388](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7388))

Expose the workspace of the selected profile to bundle templates as `.workspace`, with `Hostname`, `ID`, and `URL`, so templates can address a workspace on a host shared by several workspaces. A template input named `workspace` takes precedence. ([#7349](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7349))
Bump dependencies with known vulnerabilities. ([#7394](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7394))
Upgrade `github.com/mattn/go-runewidth` to v0.0.31, which removes ~30ms of startup time from every command. ([#7391](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7391))
Update the Go SDK to [v0.194.0](https://github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go/releases/tag/v0.194.0). ([#7371](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7371))
Update the Go SDK to [v0.195.0](https://github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go/releases/tag/v0.195.0). ([#7384](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7384))

A variable used as the value of a secret is now sensitive: referencing it from any other field, such as a job parameter or a secret's `comment`, is an error because the value would be used in plain text. Mark other secret-holding variables with `sensitive: true` to get the same protection. ([#7288](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7288))

Fix `databricks auth login` and `databricks configure` overwriting the parent profile's host and token when saving a profile with a dotted name such as `team.prod` next to an existing `[team]`. ([#7266](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7266))

`databricks auth login` and `databricks auth token` now reject the name of an existing profile after "Create a new profile" instead of logging in to that profile. ([#7196](https://github.com/databricks/cli/pull/7196))

Set tags on operation nodes so on-run-start/on-run-end hooks are discoverable when running dbt-core with --use-v2-parser ([#16310](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16310))
Allow integer `attribute` in the `sort`, `join`, `unique`, and `groupby` Jinja filters (e.g. `sort(attribute=0)`), matching Jinja2 behavior
Match BigQuery snapshot check columns without regard to case to avoid false row changes.
Keep the existing Databricks table when a view model that replaces it fails to build without use_materialization_v2 ([#16476](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16476))

A unit test that overrides one package macro (my_package.my_macro in overrides.macros) no longer makes the package's other macros undefined, matching dbt-core ([#16477](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16477))
Support `exposure` in the list command's `--resource-type` option ([#16224](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16224))
Require matching existing and target relation types for Databricks view_update_via_alter updates ([#16538](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16538))
Fix a panic when the project directory is on a Windows network share (UNC path or mapped network drive) ([#16428](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16428))
Unit tests with `overrides.vars` no longer drop project vars; overrides layer over `--vars` like dbt Core
`var.has_var` now also reports vars passed with `--vars`, matching dbt Core
Sidecar: Fixed interpolated values for getting relation info
docs-v2 source detail page showed the first table's description instead of the source's own
Refresh an account-scoped OAuth session when a server rejects an access token before its cached expiry.
Validate refreshed OAuth credentials against the cached account and host before persisting.
Preserve Snowflake nested JSON fixture escapes and heterogeneous array values during local execution.
Commit a rebuilt metadata index only once every table has been written, so a write that fails partway through leaves the previous index in place instead of a mix of new and stale files.
Add copy_grants support to Snowflake dynamic tables
Find user-installed dbt executables and Windows virtual environments reliably.

Fix the `Downloading relations` progress bar rendering as a stuck 0/N bar. Adapters with no per-item progress reporting now render a spinner instead; Snowflake now reports real per-schema progress so its bar fills as expected
Replace `DBT_AI_PROVIDER` with `DBT_ENGINE_AI_PROVIDER` ([#16312](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16312))

The environment variables behind `--generate-info-schema` and `--info-schema-dir` are now `DBT_ENGINE_GENERATE_INFO_SCHEMA` and `DBT_ENGINE_INFO_SCHEMA_DIR`. They were named `DBT_GENERATE_INFO_SCHEMA` and `DBT_INFO_SCHEMA_DIR`, outside the reserved `DBT_ENGINE_` prefix that the engine's other variables use. The flags themselves are unchanged.

Setting `DBT_ENGINE_AI_PROVIDER` no longer aborts the invocation. The variable was moved onto the reserved `DBT_ENGINE_` prefix without being registered as a known engine variable, so `validate_engine_env_vars` rejected it as user-authored and every command that reached setup exited 1 with dbt1005.
Support credential-independent profile metadata and scoped environment values while preserving secret access rules.
Match BigQuery partition fields case-insensitively when inspecting existing tables ([#14646](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/14646))
Accept compute_region and legacy dataproc_region together in BigQuery profiles.
Populate complete query tags for Databricks seeds; fix materialization type for seeds to be `seed` rather than `table` ([#15931](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15931))
BigQuery unit tests no longer leak partition pseudocolumns into expected results ([#15357](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15357))
Fix broken image links in documentation ([#16288](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16288))
Protect Windows process environment variables from project .env overrides.
Replace deprecated DuckDB single-arrow lambdas with Python-style lambda syntax.
Reuse cached relation metadata when checking stale views during development cloning.
Honor valid dbt Core-generated package lock checksums for common package declarations with best-effort compatibility.

Correct how dbt State classifies model materializations: materialized views submit as VIEW, adapter-specific materializations such as dynamic tables and metric views submit as DBT_CUSTOM (and are therefore no longer eligible as clone candidates), semantic views are no longer submitted, and full-refreshed snapshots submit as FULL
Databricks: include all models in catalog.json for schemas with more than 50 relations ([#15795](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15795))
Report the effective dbt State defer-to target, honoring a target's `defer_to_target`, instead of always reporting the default.

Order a unit test's render after the seed that materializes an overlapping source, so dbt build no longer reads the relation before the seed has created it. This ordering now also holds when the tested model is not selected, for example when only the seed and the unit test are selected
Preserve BigQuery GEOGRAPHY, TIMESTAMP, and JSON types in dbt OSS unit test fixtures ([#16410](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16410))
Exempt ad-hoc inline (preview) nodes from the model access check, so `dbt show --inline` and `dbt compile --inline` can `ref()` a private or protected model
Fix Redshift OAuth authentication failures with an updated ADBC driver.
Add new STRUCT and ARRAY columns to BigQuery snapshot tables with their SQL types instead of `RECORD` or the array's element type ([#16350](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16350))

Keep the microbatch event-time filter on relations derived from a ref with include(), quote(), replace_path(), incorporate() or without_identifier() ([#16383](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16383))
Refresh persisted unit-test given fixture schemas so warehouse DDL changes are reflected.
Send Redshift's case-sensitive sqlglot dialect setting to the server when enable_case_sensitive_identifier is enabled
Fix DuckDB seeds defined in packages failing to load because the CSV path duplicated the package directory.
Add duckdb__date dispatch macro so dbt.date() / dbt.date_spine() work on DuckDB targets
Retry transient Redshift query-execution errors (catalog races, serialization conflicts) on the same connection
Warn on missing persist_docs columns for Databricks table, incremental, materialized view, and streaming table; fix V2 column comments being gated on the wrong persist_docs config key
Snowflake incremental models on catalog-linked databases (e.g. Glue) no longer fail on `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` of the `__dbt_tmp` relation

Time Machine replay: rebuild the relations of a recorded `list_relations_in_parallel` result instead of replaying every listed schema as empty, so `--defer` no longer treats nodes present in the dev schema as absent and re-points their refs at the deferred relation
Time Machine replay now preserves Snowflake column precision/scale (e.g. NUMBER(38,6), TIMESTAMP_LTZ(6)) so unit-test fixture SQL matches the recording
Finalize invocation telemetry when execution ends even if background workers retain descendant spans.
Fix DuckDB and Databricks incremental/snapshot builds panicking with an unhandled Arrow BinaryView type on BLOB/binary columns ([#16364](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16364))
Include the underlying cause in package hub and tarball request errors, and stop reporting a 500 status when no response was received

Auto-exposures discovered from BI tools now carry the target's adapter instead of defaulting to Snowflake, so non-Snowflake projects no longer fail selection with dbt1005 'selected nodes need adapters the target does not declare'
Stop emitting the `with connection` clause for BigQuery Iceberg tables using `lakehouse_catalog` (LRC) when `use_catalogs_v2` is left at its default.
Inline SQL and CSV unit-test fixture file contents into the parsed manifest and resolve fixtures in dependency packages. ([#16354](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16354))
Respect project-level overrides of create_schema and other adapter macros invoked from Rust. ([#16346](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16346))
Avoid unsafe CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE operations in BigQuery incremental and snapshot materializations. ([#15953](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15953))
Fix BigQuery incremental models being recreated instead of merged when a concurrent table drop makes a dataset listing fail
Skip per-table metadata when hydrating the BigQuery relation cache through ADBC GetObjects. ([#16425](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16425))
BigQuery freshness checks are now faster and safer. Freshness scans for different schemas now run at the same time. Freshness checks for the same schema and different nodes now share one request.
Strip CR and BOM from PEM-headered Snowflake private keys so keys saved with Windows line endings decode correctly ([#15107](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15107))
Snowflake seeds now honor the `transient` config instead of silently creating a permanent table
Fetch the tested model's schema for incremental unit tests with static analysis enabled instead of failing with dbt9002
Process explainer GetExplainMessage requests in batches.
Preserve BigQuery decimal and nested types in unit test fixtures ([#16440](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16440))
Correct the `dbt show --info` help text, which still said a prior `--generate-info-schema` run was required

DuckDB unit test fixtures for TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE columns are no longer cast to a naive timestamp, which previously dropped the offset and shifted the value by the session timezone ([#16470](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16470))
Fix dbt-dist recursion on version manager shims ([#16537](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16537))

Fix `--write-index` and `--dirty` runs missing files added since the last parse: new models, seeds, macros and other resources are now loaded, `--dirty` selects newly added SQL models and analyses, and `--no-partial-load` now turns off the cached-state shortcut.
Honor OS-assigned loopback ports in OAuth authorization and token-exchange callback URLs.

Recognize `$$...$$` dollar-quoted strings in the Databricks SQL lexer so a `;` inside a metric view's YAML body (e.g. in a `comment:` block) no longer truncates the compiled `create or replace view` DDL. ([#16385](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16385))
Return an empty column list when Databricks get_columns_in_relation targets a missing hive_metastore relation ([#16472](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16472))
Clarify the warning for a package-lock.yml written by an older dbt version and point to `dbt deps`
Removed lingering 'dbt' naming from parse-failure and warn_error_options log output, and pointed the parse-failure suggestion at the dbt v2 upgrade guide.
Bring Databricks macros in line with dbt-databricks v1.12.4
Fix nil pointer dereference panic in BigQuery foundry driver
Add ability to record seeds as transient table types for Snowflake
Convert Arrow FixedSizeList values to Jinja so Snowflake VECTOR columns do not panic when read into an agate table.
Databricks Python models: wait for the all-purpose cluster to be running before creating the execution context, surface Command API error messages, and stop warning on an unset timeout
Bump lake compute driver to enable jwt authentication users to no longer need a background pat to be generated.
Repeating a single-value flag such as `--target` or `--debug` keeps the last value instead of failing with a usage error, matching dbt Core.
Send allow_clones, is_defer_to_profile, and defer_enabled on dbt State submit requests for explainer parity
[Redshift] Fix issues with external OAuth breaking for multi-threaded execution ([#15555](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15555))
Write `warn_error_options` to `run_results.json` args, matching dbt Core.

Databricks: views and metric views under an iceberg catalog no longer fail with 'materialized must be incremental, table, or seed' when catalogs.yml v2 is enabled. ([#16474](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16474))
Stop panicking on Jinja AgateTable comparisons; compare tables by identity like dbt 1.x ([#15920](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/15920))
Fix `model.resource_type` returning model for all resource types during parse ([#16637](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16637))
Build source relations the same way as `source()`, so they skip the adapter's max identifier length check (matching dbt Core) and use `catalog_name` as the database
Fix BigQuery table models being dropped before every rebuild when a cluster_by entry is backtick-quoted or differs in letter case from the stored column
Restore connection wait telemetry for runtime pool contention on task operations.
Include semantic_manifest.json in the artifact ingest upload when the run writes it
A microbatch model's idle time and duration no longer overcount waits of its concurrent batches; the model is idle only while none of its batches runs
After a concurrent microbatch batch fails, batches not yet started are canceled instead of running after their model has failed

Verify TLS certificates against the operating system's certificate store instead of a bundled CA list, so HTTPS connections work behind TLS-inspecting proxies whose CA is only installed in the OS store.
Always mark reused passing dbt State tests as reused in run results.
Refresh README with a dbt v2.0 DAG screenshot stored in `assets/` and point the CI badge at the current `dbt-labs/dbt` workflow.
Allow metadata freshness checks to use an explicit artifact directory.
Allow base Jinja context builders to reuse a caller-provided ResultStore.
Log a warning naming the relation when no schema is returned for a dangling source during static analysis hydration, instead of skipping it silently.
Reuse the parsed Jinja AST when extracting unrendered config() arguments.
Extend package metadata with cross-project environment routing fields.
dbt-parser: avoid a second, redundant Jinja parse when statically recovering source() calls hidden in a conditional branch during model, function, and singular data test rendering

Add a per-resource-type applicability table for adapter-specific config keys, replacing the shared WarehouseSpecificNodeConfig field list with per-(resource type, key) status. A key set on a resource type that does not support it now emits a DeprecatedConfigKey warning. On schema.yml and inline config() the key is still applied, so behavior is unchanged; in dbt_project.yml, where the key has no field to deserialize into and already warned, it is dropped.
Time Machine replay pins the Jinja wall clock to the recording start, so wall-clock-derived SQL (e.g. a `utcnow()`-based var) matches the recorded text
Add force closing of span subtrees to dbt-tracing, ending a span's structured telemetry even while other handles to it or its descendants are alive.
docs-v2: document the __overview__ landing-page customization block in the README
Ignore `flags:` in installed packages' `dbt_project.yml`: project flags, including behavior change and adapter behavior flags, only apply from the root project

Update ADBC drivers to Snowflake 0.21.21, BigQuery 0.21.23, BigQuery Foundry 0.1.11, Databricks 0.21.15, Redshift 0.18.11, Spark 0.1.4, DuckDB Extended 0.0.32, Lake Compute 0.1.13, and MSSQL 1.7.1 (dbt build suffixes).

Harden Databricks logged-SQL credential redaction: match `credential` and `encryption` clauses case-insensitively, redact every clause rather than only the first, and correctly handle option values containing commas, newlines, quotes or escaped quotes and keys containing dots. ([#16053](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/16053))

Upgrade gix to 0.84.0 to address security advisories in the gix dependency family.
Update BigQuery and Spark ADBC driver builds to Go 1.26.10.
Update rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs to 1.0.10 to reject distrusted certificate chains.
